_comment: Synthetic OSM element stream for the private Sfax/Kerkennah topology
pilot. Shaped like Overpass/osmium JSON output so the pure snapshot
builder can be driven without the 84MB .pbf, which is gitignored and
Nodes 2-5 carry no power tag: they exist only to prove that topology
node coordinates referenced by power ways are retained, which is what
lets way-based substation way/20 share node 3 with line way/10 and end
up in the same connected component as node substation node/1.
node/900 and way/30 sit in Tunis, outside the Sfax/Kerkennah bounding
box, and must not survive a bounded extract.
relation/200 is a power relation with an unsupported structure type;
relation/300 is a supported type whose member is another relation;
relation/400's only member is out-of-box way/30, so nothing it names
is in the extract. All three are quarantined explicitly rather than
silently skipped -- a silent skip is indistinguishable from 'there was
nothing there', and it is also what a broken member-type mapping in
